channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Indian Rupee: Hedging demand rises on bond gains – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Geoff Yu highlights that INR faces strong selling pressure from a rebalancing perspective, as Indian bonds have outperformed major peers. With INR flows broadly flat, FX exposure has risen and investors are advised to keep hedging elevated after strong duration gains.

item.title: Gold extends recovery to $4,050 amid softer USD; upside seems limited ahead of FOMC
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) builds on its steady intraday recovery from an over one-week low and climbs back closer to the $4,050 level heading into the European session on Wednesday.

item.title: US Dollar: Hawkish Fed hold may support USD – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lloyd Chan expects the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) to deliver a hawkish hold, with the Federal Reserve (Fed) keeping rates unchanged while stressing elevated inflation risks. He notes softer recent US data but highlights that markets still price some probability of a July hike.

item.title: Iraqi PM calls for urgent security meeting after Saudi-US strikes
item.description: Iraqi Prime Minister (PM) Ali Faleh al-Zaydi has called for an urgent security meeting on Wednesday following a joint military operation from Saudi Arabia and the United States (US), according to a statement.

item.title: Equities: Record highs with tech under pressure – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank analysts note that lower oil prices and bond yields supported US equities, helping the equal-weighted S&P 500 reach a record high as investors rotated into defensive and non-tech sectors.

item.title: Japanese Yen recovery halts below 163.30 US Dollar with Fed’s decision on tap
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) has trimmed some losses against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, but USD/JPY dips have been capped above previous highs, in the 163.30 area so far.

item.title: Indian Rupee corrects after three-day advance as oil price rebounds
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades marginally lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday after a three-day winning streak. The USD/INR pair rebounds to near 95.85, the intraday high, as oil prices have rebounded strongly due to revived geopolitical risks.

item.title: Oil: Volatile on Iran conflict swings – UOB
item.description: UOB strategists report that Oil prices initially fell sharply as the United States (US) military campaign against Iran remained paused, with WTI dropping to USD 79.26 and Brent to USD 84.10.

item.title: Iran officially rejects Oman’s regional joint Hormuz management proposal
item.description: According to a senior official from Iran, the nation doesn’t support Oman's proposal for regional joint management of Strait of Hormuz, a critical chokepoint for almost 20% of global energy supply.

item.title: Euro edges higher against US Dollar, focus is on Fed’s policy
item.description: The Euro (EUR) ticks higher against the US Dollar (USD) at around 1.1393 during the European trading session on Wednesday. The major currency pair edges up as the US Dollar is slightly down ahead of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy announcement at 18:00 GMT.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Fed and energy drivers outweigh BoJ – ING
item.description: ING’s Chris Turner and Padhraic Garvey expect the Bank of Japan to keep its policy rate at 1.00% on 31 July, with any modestly hawkish shift seen as unlikely to materially boost the Yen or change the USD/JPY trajectory.

item.title: South Korean Won nears four-month highs despite the KOSPI index selloff
item.description: The South Korean Won (KRW) extends gains for the second consecutive day against the US Dollar (USD), and is set for a 6.5% monthly rally. Strong South Korean macroeconomic data and market expectations of monetary tightening by the Bank of Korea have offset the KOSPI Index’s sell-off.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Likely revisit 50-day high above $92 on renewed US-Iran attacks
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), futures on NYMEX, trade 3.2% higher at around $81.00 during the early European trading session on Wednesday.

item.title: Euro: Softer Fed signals may lift EUR against US Dollar - Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Antje Praefcke argues that the FOMC under Chair Kevin Warsh is likely to deliver a "hawkish hold", with markets already pricing at least one Fed rate hike by year-end.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Seems vulnerable near 0.6950 after soft CPI-driven breakdown
item.description: The AUD/USD pair attracts sellers for the third straight day on Wednesday and dives to an over two-week trough following the release of softer Australian consumer inflation figures.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah gains as Fed uncertainty weighs on US Dollar
item.description: USD/IDR depreciates after two days of gains, trading around 18,120 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. However, the pair has lost ground as the US Dollar (USD) struggles ahead of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) upcoming policy decision.

item.title: Iran's IRGC confirms striking US base in Jordan
item.description: In European trade on Wednesday, the Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) announces that it fired several ballistic missiles at a United States (US) air base and the military Central Command (CENTCOM) center in Jordan.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar holds steady below 0.5900 vs USD as traders seem hesitant ahead of FOMC
item.description: The NZD/USD pair struggles to build on the overnight bounce from the 0.5860 horizontal support and seesaws between tepid gains/minor losses during the Asian session on Wednesday.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Wednesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: British Pound gains ground as US Dollar struggles ahead of Fed decision
item.description: GBP/USD edges higher after remaining flat in the previous day, trading around 1.3300 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The currency pair gains ground as the US Dollar (USD) struggles ahead of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) upcoming policy decision.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Eyes rising wedge top at 187.00
item.description: EUR/JPY moves little after registering modest gains in the previous day, trading around 186.60 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The currency cross is maintaining a bullish near-term tone as it holds above both the nine-period and 50-period Exponential Moving Averages (EMAs).

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD gains even as oil prices rebound, Fed policy awaited
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) trades 1.14% higher to near $57.80 during the Asian trading session on Wednesday. The white metal gains even as oil prices rebound strongly due to renewed conflicts between the United States (US) and Iran.

item.title: Euro advances as US Dollar declines ahead of Fed policy decision
item.description: EUR/USD holds ground for the second successive day, trading around 1.1390 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: Canadian Dollar remains on the front foot as USD bulls turn cautious ahead of Fed decision
item.description: The USD/CAD pair is seen consolidating around the 1.4100 mark during the Asian session as traders keenly await the outcome of a two-day FOMC policy meeting, due later this Wednesday.

item.title: United States Dollar Index (DXY) flat below 101.50 as bulls await FOMC amid Iran risks
item.description: The United States Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, is seen consolidating below the 101.50 level during the Asian session as traders await the outcome of a two-day FOMC meeting, due later this Wednesday.

item.title: Australia’s CPI inflation cools to 3.8% YoY in June vs. 4% forecast
item.description: Australia’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) increased by 3.8% year-over-year (YoY) in June, compared to a 4% growth reported in May, the latest data published by the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) showed on Wednesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar falls to one-week low vs Yen as soft CPI triggers heavy selling
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross extends this week's retracement slide from the 114.65 zone, or its highest level since June 3, and attracts some follow-through selling for the second straight day.

item.title: Australian Dollar slips as softer inflation cools domestic rate expectations
item.description: AUD/USD depreciates for the second successive day, trading around 0.6970 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair falls as the Australian Dollar (AUD) continues to struggle following the release of domestic Consumer Price Index (CPI) data.

item.title: US CENTCOM launches strikes in Iraq targeting Iran-backed groups
item.description: US Central Command: carried out precision strikes in Iraq targeting Iran-backed groups planning attacks on US forces and Saudi oil facilities.

item.title: Japanese Yen holds ground despite rising oil prices
item.description: USD/JPY loses ground after registering minor gains in the previous day, trading around 163.70 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair may regain ground as the Japanese Yen could come under pressure from rebounding oil prices.
